title: Kairo Knox Episode 013 — One Review Changed the AI's Mind
intended_viewer: Everyday online shoppers, students, gamers and curious technology users, not just AI engineers
audience_benefit: Understand why AI shopping recommendations can change after seeing outside information, and learn not to trust a single ranked pick without checking sources
hook_consequence: One review changed an AI shopping agent's preferred watch in a controlled study
hook_prediction: Same watches, same specs. Will the assistant make the same choice after viewing one review?
visible_proof: Original vector-animated eight-watch product grid; a BEFORE/AFTER pick switch, labelled 'ILLUSTRATIVE RECREATION — NOT A LIVE MODEL'; then a cited study result from one tested model-and-source condition
teachable_payoff: A model recommendation may be influenced by source exposure and context; compare specifications and inspect sources rather than assuming the first ranking is objective
optional_humor: So the AI shopper did what humans do: read one review and suddenly have a new favorite.
rights_status: original vector animations only; external paper figures and third-party clips are NOT cleared
